action: Patients of Monadnock Community Hospital: use the hospital's website notices for service changes and be wary of unsolicited calls about your records. Other hospitals: confirm downtime procedures and diversion plans.
date_note: Date of the hospital notice confirming a cyber incident; the outage began November 9.
exec: A small New Hampshire hospital had ambulance diversions and cancelled appointments after an IT outage, showing how a cyber incident hits patient care at rural hospitals.
impact: Phone and network outage from November 9 with ambulance diversions and appointment cancellations, per a DysruptionHub report relayed by a law-firm page; hospital says it is identifying potentially affected data.
plain: A New Hampshire hospital's phones and computer network went down on November 9. The hospital now says it was a cyber incident.

sources.name: ClassAction.org (relays hospital's November 16 notice and DysruptionHub report)

summary: Monadnock Community Hospital in New Hampshire had a phone and network outage starting November 9, with ambulance diversions and cancelled appointments, according to a DysruptionHub report relayed by a law-firm page. That page says the hospital's November 16 website notice confirms a cybersecurity incident and that it is working to identify affected data. No data exposure, ransom or group claim is reported.
title: Monadnock Community Hospital (New Hampshire) confirms cyber incident behind network outage and ambulance diversion
